label: Trip objective: shared family interaction/balance > optimizing around one age subgroup.
Planning/logistics: organized, convenient family logistics > high-friction adventure logistics.
Pace: comfortable/moderate schedule with rest > tightly packed sightseeing.
Value: high quality-to-cost value > either cheapest-possible or unnecessary luxury.
Experience style: self-planned/deeper experience > generic mass-tour itinerary.
Destination character: nature + historical/cultural elements > purely resort-only environment.
Accommodation: warm/family-friendly lodging > business-style impersonal lodging.
Activity planning: include age-appropriate child activities > adult-only itinerary with children accommodated secondarily.
